standard_prerequisites.name: Setup and dual of the perfect complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes K = Rf_*(E-dual tensor G-bullet) and the dual E-dual.

standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor-form base change computation
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the functorial isomorphisms and their boundary compatibility for E-dual and G-bullet.

core_obligations: Recall from the carded setup lemma that K = Rf_*(E-dual tensor^L G-bullet) for the dual perfect complex E-dual.
Display Ext^i_{O_X}(E, G-bullet tensor f^*F) = H^i(X, E-dual tensor^L (G-bullet tensor f^*F)) by construction of the dual.
Apply the carded tensor-form computation to E-dual and G-bullet to obtain the functorial isomorphisms H^i(S, K tensor F) -> Ext^i_{O_X}(E, G-bullet tensor f^*F).
Boundary compatibility: display the commutative squares from the two distinguished triangles; the source omits the commutativity verification - carry it as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Dual setup; Ext-to-cohomology identification; carded computation application; boundary obligation.
difficulty_reason: A transport of the tensor-form computation to Ext form through perfect duality; short and complete.
